(1) the use of sound to represent multidimentional data is feasible, and that (2) the use of apparent sound source location and sound repetition to represent data in time and space is a promising method of doing so.
auditory displays are a useful complement to visual displays for the exploration of multidimensional data.

the development of a workstation to aid in the visualization of multidirectional data.
the development of a workstation to support the exploratory visualization of multidimensional datasets.
the development of an integrated auditory and visual display for the purpose of facilitating the exploratory visualization of multidimensional scientific and engineering data.

the Exvis project is an attempt to develop a workstation for the exploratory visualization of multidimensional information.
